- [ ] No individual private well owners or water-rights holders are named.
- [ ] No causation or personal-impact language crept into synthesis or copy.
- [ ] The cinematic investigation sequence still flows without stalls (if UI was touched).
- [ ] Copy matches the product voice: spare, concrete, never dramatized.
